Want your own app, but you can't code, and can't pay a developer? You can build one with Claude. Today.
Ronnie keeps his customer credit in a notebook. Who owes what, since when. Pages everywhere.
So he opens Claude, and simply describes the app he wants.
Make me a credit tracker. Add customers and amounts, show who's overdue, and total what I'm owed.
Claude builds it right there, next to the chat. A working app, not just a picture.
Want changes? Just ask. Add a WhatsApp reminder button. Show it in Hindi. Make the buttons bigger.
Claude updates the app in seconds.
When it's ready, he taps Share. Anyone with the link can use it, like his helper at the counter.
And on Claude's desktop app, he can even install it, with its own icon.
To be fair, this is perfect for simple tools. For a big app with logins and payments, you'll need more, like Claude Code, or a developer.
Try it with sample data first, and check every number.
You don't need to code. You need a clear idea. Comment, app, for the prompt.
